## Summary
Use explicit checks and rollback.

## Decision
Deploy with canary and monitoring.

## Rationale
This reduces blast radius.

## Trade-offs
| Option | Pros | Cons | When to Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Canary | Safer | Slower rollout | Production changes |

## Next Steps
1. Define SLOs.
2. Add rollback guardrails.
